title.narrative: Strengthening local governance and peaceful coexistence in South Sudan

description.narrative:
he Overall Objective of the Action is to contribute to local community peace and resilience in South Sudan.

The Specific Objectives (outcome) of the Action are:

¿Specific Objective 1: Enhanced effectiveness of subnational governance structures on in-ter-and-intra communal peace dialogues and in addressing discriminatory gender/social norms.

¿Specific Objective 2: Improved efficiency and accessibility of basic services provided by subnational governance structures, in particularly addressing the needs of women and youth.

description.narrative: To contribute to local community peace and resilience in South Sudan

title.narrative: Indicator 1: In 6 partner counties, 120 of 150 selected representatives of the local population rate the quality of local governance on a scale of 1 to 5 with an average of 3 (sufficient)

description.narrative: Criteria for assessing local governance include the quality of political and social participation, citizenoriented service delivery, inclusive planning, transparent accountability, and the rule of law.
